text:
maria: Heads-up — planning an index + backfill for events.user_id_idx in Wednesday 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Need deploybot pin, canary, and rollback. Quick thread to align.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window accepted. Deploy job: migrator/2023-add-user-idx queued. Use --concurrent-index and backfill chunked. ETA 40m. Will post status updates.

ankit: What's the estimated exclusive lock time? If we use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY should be no exclusive lock, but backfill writes could spike WAL and IO. Need throttling.

sam: We should do a canary on a tiny shard first and run the same chunker against a read-replica to measure WAL and CPU impact. Also pre-warm application caches for queries that will hit the new index.

maria: Proposed plan:
1) Canary on shard where user_id % 100 < 5 (isolated)
2) Run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY on that shard + small backfill
3) If canary looks good, roll out index concurrently across remaining shards, chunked backfill with max_workers=4 and rate_limit=200 writes/sec
4) Validate with select counts and sample query latencies

release-coordinator: Addendum: Pin migrator binary to v1.14.2 for this rollout. If we need to rollback, steps in runbook:
```
-- pause job
./migrator cancel --id $JOB_ID
./migrator rollback --to-tag v1.14.1
```
Make sure to capture the $JOB_ID from deploy-bot output.

ops-oncall: Put these alerts on for the window: replication lag > 30s, DB CPU > 75% for 5m, write latency p99 > 300ms, wal_size growth > 20% in 5m. On alert we will throttle backfill to 1 worker or pause entirely. Pager set to @ops-oncall.

ankit: Also add a post-index constraint validation step: run `SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE user_id IS NULL;` and checksum on sample partitions to ensure no corruption. If checksum fails, abort and escalate.

maria: Can deploy-bot post canary completion status with tag canary=true and job id so we can approve the full rollout? Also want a quick smoke test command.

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 2023456990. Job id 59213. No elevated CPU or replication lag observed during the 10m observation. Metrics: db_cpu_p95 42%, replication_lag 2s. Proceeding with rollout stage 1 (25% shards). Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.internal/db-backfills (watch query latency, wal usage). Will post at each stage.

sam: Pre-create a maintenance toggle for the downstream feature that depends on this index. If p99 for queries spikes, flip the toggle and revert to the old path for 5-10m.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Secondary oncall is @julia. Escalation: if alert persists >10m escalate to infra lead.

maria: Agreed. If we need to rollback, coordinate with oncall + release-coordinator. Otherwise we'll close thread after final success and I'll file release notes with the index name, job id, and metrics (latency delta, cost).

deploy-bot: Rollout completed at 2023457000. Index created using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, backfill finished. No alerts fired. Job 59213 closed. :tada:

maria: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll push a short release note and attach the metric screenshots. Archive after 24h.
